zone_deltas.key_change: Promotion logic was partially reordered to source-code-order first-match-wins (RFC-040 D2 style), but the proposed deletion of the _has_image_rescue bypass was not done and a new source_selection=True path now bypasses _apply_clamp entirely, so bug count grew from 5 to 8.

The proposed consolidation into one shared detect_garble kernel appears implemented (no more duplicate tree/flat implementations), but NFKC still runs before the bidi presentation-form signal for some callers and a new config.garble_short_text_default hard override was added, growing bug count from 5 to 7.

zone_deltas.zone_name: OCR Recovery Cascade and Kill-Switch Conflation
zone_deltas.key_change: The proposed kill-switch split and marker-removal-after-coverage-skip fixes were not implemented -- _OCR_ESCALATION is still a single switch conflating page-level and per-picture OCR and <!-- image --> markers still leak into output -- and a new string-matching fragility in indexer.py's gate-reason routing was found, growing bug count from 4 to 6.

zone_deltas.zone_name: Converter Chain Fallback and AGPL Gating
zone_deltas.key_change: No simplification proposal existed for this zone previously; severity escalated medium to high and bug count doubled because structural (not just transient) failures still silently walk the chain to AGPL converters, and the remote Docling service still has no version/contract enforcement.

The proposed NFKC-reorder ahead of the bidi coherence check and the remote-image version-check assertion were not implemented; only a compensating heuristic (assuming presentation forms when none survive) was added as a partial workaround, leaving severity and bug count unchanged.

Severity dropped high to medium, but the two core proposed fixes -- table-aware shared char-count signal and a fail-loud scoring harness -- were not implemented (block.get('text','') and the ERROR-default harness bug both persist), and bug count rose 3 to 4 as the self-reinforcing blind-spot cycle was characterized more precisely.

zone_deltas.zone_name: Erasure Cascade and Storage Consistency Drift
zone_deltas.key_change: Severity dropped high to medium with bug count flat at 2; the manually-maintained erasure-manifest mechanism is largely unchanged, but the verdict dual-write/consistency complexity this zone's prior mechanism described was split out into its own new zone, narrowing this zone's remaining scope.

new_zones: Dual-Writer Verdict Persistence and Consistency Model Split

The pageindex project has completed 16 corpus reingestion audit runs over 2 months (early July - mid August 2026), cycling through verdict gate hardening (RFC-025, RFC-026) and remediation efforts. Key findings:

**Past Cycle Outcomes:**
- Run 15→Run 16 scorecard: 3 document improvements, 6 regressions (2 new ERROR/FAIL), 7 persistent stalls
- Prior fabricated corpus report claimed 15 PASS / 10 MARGINAL / 0 FAIL; actual verified numbers: 11 PASS / 12 MARGINAL / 2 FAIL (RFC-015)
- Persistent judge-vs-gate verdict divergence: audit QA identifies FAIL documents that persist as PASS (RTL/Presentation Forms defects caught only at scoring stage, not persisted verdict gate)

**Regression Patterns - Arabic/RTL Documents (Chronic):**
- cabinet_resolution_no_96_of_2023: complete artifact loss (Run 15→16 transition)
- Federal Decree-Law 13/2022 (مرسوم 13/2022): 36% mojibake, ratifying authority name corrupted
- Cabinet Resolution 1/2022 (قرار 1): embedded Latin fragments (LAI, oll, poe, Lele) in Arabic legal prose, plus duplicated garbled letterhead OCR across all 21 pages
- مرسوم 33/2021 Arabic: new control-char insertions, garble gate still reports 0 despite findings
- Data Governance Policy, Cabinet Decision 106/2022: embedded Latin garble, same pattern found in 4 documents

**Wiring Failures - Zone 4 (Garble Detection Fragmentation):**
- NFKC normalization at converters.py:2357 decomposes Arabic Presentation Forms (U+FB50-FEFF) before bidi coherence detector runs, yielding 0% true-positive rate by construction
- expected_script parameter hardcoded to None at multiple call sites (classify_verdict, _script_from_filename), breaking Latin-gibberish detection
- ScriptContext constructed once at indexer.py:1150 with correct had_presentation_forms field, but throwaway ScriptContext objects (gates.py:90, pictures.py:283/401, indexer.py:760) discard this with had_presentation_forms=False
- Duplicated helper functions (_garble_ratio, ocr_noise_ratio, hash_pipe_ratio) byte-identical in tree_validation.py and garble.py
- check_garble legacy shim rebuilds GarbleConfig from os.environ on every call, bypassing frozen pipeline_config

**Wiring Failures - Zone 5 (Converter-Gate-Route Ordering):**
- _reconvert_and_revalidate (indexer.py:346-353) and _recover_rtl_repair (recovery.py:434-440) update gate_result/ok/reason but omit first_defect/route, creating stale-routing window
- Workaround match arms (indexer.py:1247-1260) and dead ad-hoc re-derivation block (1210-1218) exist only to paper over stale-routing bug
- OCR capability detection relies on fragile string-matching 'docling' in converter names vs typed supports_ocr flag

**Chronic Cross-Zone Issues:**
- Promotion-path gate bypass: وارد 597 (barcode OCR, 100% garbage 3,208 chars) persists as PASS via image_enrichment_promoted because char-floor checks volume not content validity
- Meta char counter divergence: Unfallversicherung's flat_char_count=7,471 counts recovered text never landing in persisted blocks (~15x overstatement)
- world-stats-pocketbook-2023.pdf: 67% char loss (6.19M→2.03M) between runs despite PASS verdict maintained (flat→tree format change unexplained)
- Table extraction gaps (Unfallversicherung), chart OCR semantically scrambled (uae_numbers landscape) remain stalled 7+ runs
- Image enrichment producing junk OCR (duplicated garbled letterhead blocks)

**User Feedback & Scorecard Accuracy:**
- RFC-015 formally documented that prior corpus report was fabricated (not derived from real MinIO meta.json); user's independent verification in Run 10 audit report confirmed divergence
- Run 10/16 reports distinguish "audit verdicts" (expert QA judgment) from "stored gate verdicts" (pipeline classify_verdict output) as separate verdict tracks — high-severity finding
- user email: ccdev1@inheaden.io; no other user corrections recorded in memory
